war_summary: War 139 is on day 113 with no winner and remains focused on several highly contested fronts. Endless Shore is the most volatile region, with 49 strategic-base events in 24 hours, accelerating casualties, and an even 5–5 ownership split. Oarbreaker has comparable churn at 46 events and a heavily contested 8–1 Warden–Colonial distribution, while Clahstra and Godcrofts show active, accelerating combat alongside mixed ownership and recent flips. Callahan’s Passage continues to generate substantial casualty volume and has recorded six base events around Overlook Hill and Scáth Passing. Onyx is another contested, high-casualty region with 11 recent events and a 4–2 Colonial advantage. Most other regions have little or no recent ownership movement and appear comparatively stable.
